selected_evidence.requirement: Create a local certificate authority named OS Comparison Root CA
selected_evidence.summary: Direct inspection showed matching subject and issuer CNs, critical CA:TRUE and certificate-signing constraints, a valid private key, and matching certificate/key public keys.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install the certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
selected_evidence.summary: The trust database was rebuilt; default-system and explicit-bundle verification returned OK, while p11-kit listed the certificate as an authority trust anchor.

Healthy baseline boot ID 54bd1c3e-3a1b-4913-841b-88512119e096 was captured, the reboot was acknowledged asynchronously, and recovered boot ID 2a72e12d-e0c2-470f-9f04-0a082ec92aa7 proved a restart. Post-reboot checks showed system_state=running, persistent CA files, a valid matching key, and successful system-trust verification.

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 077
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:4096 -sha256 -days 3650 -nodes -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' -keyout /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
chown root:root /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
chmod 600 /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
chmod 644 /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
if command -v restorecon >/dev/null 2>&1; then restorecon /etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; fi
printf 'created\n'

set -eu
cert=/etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
key=/etc/pki/tls/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
stat -c 'path=%n owner=%U:%G mode=%a size=%s' "$cert" "$key"
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -subject -issuer -dates -fingerprint -sha256
openssl x509 -in "$cert" -noout -text | grep -A4 'X509v3 Basic Constraints'
openssl pkey -in "$key" -check -noout
cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -in "$cert" -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
key_pub=$(openssl pkey -in "$key" -pubout -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$cert_pub" = "$key_pub" ]
printf 'key_certificate_public_key_match=yes sha256=%s\n' "$cert_pub"
printf 'default-system-trust: '
openssl verify "$cert"
printf 'explicit-ca-bundle: '
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt "$cert"
trust list --filter=ca-anchors | grep -A3 -B1 'OS Comparison Root CA'
